statement: Replace the raw-SQL deployQueryLoopService scaffolding in examples/service-data-affinity/run-affinity-demo.js with a genuine public WASI call-Binding deployment over call_cell_reduce_slots and call_cell_reduce_results, and attribute data-local Call Cell shard reads to service_partition_access.

constraints.statement: Remove deployQueryLoopService, raw INSERT INTO config, raw INSERT INTO service_definitions, and user-created movielens_top10 / movielens_top10_reduce_slots tables from examples/service-data-affinity/run-affinity-demo.js with no fallback.

Deploy the MovieLens Top-N ranking service through the public WASI Binding.call pipeline (runGenerate, runBuild, runDeploy) and invoke it via CALL BINDING over call_cell_reduce_slots and call_cell_reduce_results.

Attribute data-local Call Cell shard partition reads to service_partition_access on the local SQL engine and wake runtime-service rebalancers on call_activation_leases and service_partition_access updates.
